nodes.name: runtime.ts
nodes.summary: Runtime IPC helpers bridging the frontend to the Tauri window/clipboard APIs, including a window-focus subscription used to refresh state on regained focus.

nodes.name: onWindowFocus
nodes.summary: Subscribes to the Tauri window focus-changed event and invokes the callback whenever the window regains focus, returning an unlisten cleanup function.

nodes.name: motion.ts
nodes.summary: Motion helpers exposing prefers-reduced-motion-aware durations and distances (fast, normal, shift) so transitions collapse to zero when the user disables animation.

nodes.name: nav-items.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for the app's top-level navigation destinations, plus a titleFor helper mapping a pathname to its display label, consumed by the sidebar, mobile bottom bar, and app-bar title.

nodes.name: platform.ts
nodes.summary: Platform detection flags (isMac, isWindows, isMobile) and the modifier-key label derived from the user agent, driving OS-specific window chrome and shortcut hints.

nodes.name: safe-area.ts
nodes.summary: Watches native safe-area insets on Android via a Tauri bridge and applies them to CSS custom properties, letting the layout clear notches, gesture rails, and the home indicator.

nodes.name: watchSafeArea
nodes.summary: Reads initial safe-area insets from the native bridge, subscribes to inset-change events, and returns a teardown that removes the listener.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Shared class-name utility exposing cn(), which merges clsx conditionals with tailwind-merge deduplication for Tailwind-based components.

nodes.name: +layout.svelte
nodes.summary: Root layout that wires the one responsive app shell (header, sidebar/drawer, edge-swipe) and mounts cross-route concerns: transfer/pairing event streams, native drag-drop, safe-area watching, Android back handling, and global dialogs and toasts.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 runes ($props, $state) with onMount lifecycle orchestrating multiple Tauri event subscriptions and a single teardown.

nodes.name: +layout.ts
nodes.summary: Layout load module disabling SSR (ssr = false) so the app runs as a client-side SPA inside the Tauri webview.

nodes.name: +page.svelte
nodes.summary: Home route: the main transfer surface with send/receive tabs, a mode switcher, and a dismissible transport error alert bound to the transfer app store.

nodes.name: +page.svelte
nodes.summary: Activity route wrapping the ActivityView component that logs everything sent and received.

nodes.name: +page.svelte
nodes.summary: Devices route: the home for trusted-device pairing — rename this device, show a code (with QR behind a blur veil), enter a peer's code, and rename or remove paired devices with a confirm step.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 component using $state/$effect runes, a reusable {#snippet} for edit actions, and responsive dialog/drawer for destructive confirmation.

nodes.name: layout.css
nodes.summary: Global layout stylesheet defining shell tokens (header height, safe-area insets, QR background) and cross-platform chrome styling imported by the root layout.

nodes.name: +page.svelte
nodes.summary: Settings route wrapping the SettingsView component for tuning how Floppy saves, looks, and connects.

nodes.name: svelte.config.js
nodes.summary: SvelteKit configuration using adapter-static with an index.html fallback to build the frontend as an SPA for the Tauri webview, since Tauri has no Node SSR server.

nodes.name: vite.config.js
nodes.summary: Vite configuration tailored for Tauri: Tailwind and SvelteKit plugins, a fixed strict dev port, HMR over the Tauri dev host, and ignoring src-tauri from the file watcher.
